workstreams.title: Close the cover-transfer arithmetic and certificate gaps
workstreams.summary: Retain the implemented general binary norm and declared-annihilator named-subgroup certificate, regenerated 174-map/150-binding binary certificate corpus, direct-prime degree-two transfer core through the complete deterministic-u64 and strict psi13 proof domains, exhaustive independent F5 Picard-class oracle, exact independent 20-class F2 source-law pilot, bounded GF(8) map-value oracle, balanced two-infinity arithmetic slice, bounded transfer sweeper, and completed exact-source successor cryptanalysis mirror at revision f24ebf0f59e6f55ae8ce5a651d3c25ee4dc42512 of crypto producer 153ac585d3b1ece0ebb0d49312b13267f651c94b, while keeping final remote mirror CI/review, unrestricted wide-prime and catalog-wide odd support, the remaining exact-order evidence, package replay, the full independent 486-class GF(8) source law, and broader reference coverage as separate gated changes.

deliverables.description: Partial direct-prime degree-two transfer core for C: v^2=F(u^2+c) to a direct short-Weierstrass target over odd primes proved by either the complete deterministic-u64 test or the strict Sorenson--Webster psi13 gate p < 3317044064679887385961981: balanced pullback, arbitrary balanced-class pushforward, deck action, both composition identities, and bounded independent Fp2 pointwise norm checks. Two live 73-bit rows are exercised as a strict pilot, not unrestricted wide-prime support. Normalized targets fail closed with unsupported_normalized_target_transfer_backend; primes outside the proof domain, extension fields, nonsplit infinity, and catalog-wide odd subgroup replay remain unsupported or unverified. The exhaustive independent F5 Picard-class oracle checks all 36 classes and both transfer compositions.

Implemented arbitrary-class binary Jacobian pushforward/norm and elliptic-image projector for checked cubic covers, including nonsplit support, plus a named-generator certificate that proves injectivity and degree-inverse recovery only from a checked declared annihilator coprime to degree three. The implementation makes no exact-order or primality claim. The completed exact-source successor mirror at aburan28/cryptanalysis revision f24ebf0f59e6f55ae8ce5a651d3c25ee4dc42512 is sourced from crypto producer revision 153ac585d3b1ece0ebb0d49312b13267f651c94b; its local validation passed exact 10-record parity, the 1/1 primality slice, the 5/5 balanced slice, the 6/6 transfer slice including the strict live P73 pilot, the 8/8 parity verifier, strict library Clippy, and targeted rustfmt. Final remote mirror CI/review, full independent GF(8) source-group arithmetic, and package replay remain gated.

Frozen 500,925-byte binary certificate corpus cleanly regenerated at crypto revision f402ccd4c657735e290f3a0a95b3a53024cba2cf with recorded transfer-producer source SHA-256 04fc744060ec7a4c1ced6c36f9190422d886c593d29e4bd263f223db77f36c65. The source frame explicitly binds the binary module routing and deterministic primality implementation used by exact-order evidence. It retains all 174 map records and 150 named bindings with zero failed records; 102 bindings have proved exact-order evidence and 48 remain unknown. It certifies only the recorded binary named generated subgroups and explicitly supplies no solver or computational-advantage assessment.

Independent F5 Picard-class oracle for y^2=x^6+1 that constructs its own 36-class group law from projective functions, checks the complete 36-by-36 group table, exceptional/shared-support cases, target arithmetic, and both transfer compositions. The bounded GF(8) oracle still uses production source-Jacobian addition; the separate exact F2 oracle supplies an independent source law only for its 20-class pilot. The required full 486-class GF(8) source law therefore remains open.

Independent F2 source-law and transfer oracle for E: y^2+xy=x^3+1 and H: v^2+u^2v=u^7+u. It independently derives all 20 divisor classes, the complete 400-entry group table, all 8,000 associativity triples, exceptional/shared/repeated/nonsplit support, target arithmetic, pullback, pushforward, and both composition identities before differential comparison with production. This exact tiny-field pilot does not satisfy the required full 486-class fixed-GF(8) gate.

acceptance_gates.scope: Balanced two-infinity arithmetic and degree-two induced maps cover the exact 22,243-map, 940-representation odd population at the 2026-11-18 live registry snapshot: 20,808 direct-prime maps/909 representations, 30 normalized-prime maps/22 representations, and 1,405 extension maps/9 representations, with exact membership hashes, exhaustive supported small-field checks, exceptional-divisor tests, and an independent oracle.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The balanced backend and direct-prime transfer core handle monic squarefree degree-six genus-two split models over primes proved in the complete deterministic-u64 or strict psi13 domains, with direct short-Weierstrass degree-two maps and both composition identities. This covers 20,539 live direct maps and 675 linked EC1 records, including exactly two live 73-bit pilot rows. The remaining 269 direct maps/234 bindings lack accepted primality certificates; 30 normalized maps/22 bindings have verified geometry but fail closed for transfer; and 1,405 extension maps/9 bindings lack the balanced transfer backend. The independent F5 oracle exhausts all 36 classes for one fixture. Nonsplit infinity, full live subgroup replay, and independent family-wide evidence remain open; the bounded sweeper does not close this gate.

acceptance_gates.scope: A catalog-general binary norm handles every valid reduced class for all 174 binary cubic map rows and 150 representations at the 2026-11-18 live registry snapshot, including shared, nonsplit, repeated, and exceptional support, verifies degree-three composition, exports exact EC1/ICV1/HC1/CV1 bindings and certificates, and has a current cryptanalysis mirror/integration receipt.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The native implementation handles arbitrary valid reduced classes for checked binary cubic covers and certifies degree-three composition and projectors, including exhaustive GF(8) and exact n=83 checks. It also checks named-generator injectivity and degree-inverse recovery when a declared annihilator is coprime to three, without claiming that every declared annihilator is the exact or prime order. The cleanly regenerated frozen corpus at SHA-256 8c61e842945bf1e9ad8dd3adf326c6c11e55bb97018659b2abf40a5b15256941 retains all 174 maps and 150 named bindings with zero failures, 102 proved exact-order records, and 48 unknown records. The exact F2 pilot independently checks its 20-class source law, all 400 sums, 8,000 associativity triples, both maps, and both compositions, but the fixed-GF(8) oracle still uses production source-Jacobian addition. The completed exact-source successor mirror at aburan28/cryptanalysis revision f24ebf0f59e6f55ae8ce5a651d3c25ee4dc42512 is sourced from crypto library revision 153ac585d3b1ece0ebb0d49312b13267f651c94b; its local validation passed exact 10-record parity, the 1/1 primality slice, the 5/5 balanced slice, the 6/6 transfer slice including the strict live P73 pilot, the 8/8 parity verifier, strict library Clippy, and targeted rustfmt. Final remote mirror CI/review, the full independent GF(8) source law, package replay, and every solver-advantage claim remain open.

acceptance_gates.scope: All 1,090 exact EC1/curve/map bindings at the 2026-11-18 live snapshot have exact order, image, kernel-intersection, composition, and recovery evidence: 150 binary degree-three bindings and 940 odd degree-two bindings, with separate membership hashes.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The frozen binary corpus establishes injectivity and recovery for all 150 recorded named generated subgroups under checked coprime declared annihilators, with zero failed records. It records proved exact-order evidence for 102 bindings and explicitly leaves 48 unknown. Two 73-bit direct-prime pilot generators have exact checked annihilation/recovery tests, but no catalog-bound odd subgroup corpus follows from those fixtures. The 48 unknown binary orders, all 940 odd bindings, exact image orders, kernel intersections beyond the recorded scope, and independent all-live replay remain open. Generator-level evidence does not establish every required all-element or exact-order claim.

acceptance_gates.scope: A mathematically independent implementation or pinned CAS agrees on all 486 fixed-GF(8) classes and their transfer identities, plus an exhaustive balanced genus-two fixture over an odd prime at most 31, including exceptional and shared-support cases.
acceptance_gates.rationale: The independent F5 oracle constructs and exhaustively checks a complete 36-class Picard group law and both transfer compositions without production balanced arithmetic, reduction, scalar multiplication, or target group law. The exact F2 pilot independently constructs all 20 source classes, checks all 400 sums and 8,000 associativity triples, and verifies both maps and compositions before production comparison. These satisfy only two exact tiny fixtures. The bounded GF(8) map-value oracle still delegates source addition to production, so the required independent 486-class binary source law remains absent and the combined gate stays open.

non_claims: A cover or transfer does not establish a faster destination solver.
A bounded candidate sweeper does not enumerate all mathematical transfers, and an empty bounded result is not a nonexistence proof.

The full Jacobian index-calculus solver is a separate deliverable with actual relations, checked linear algebra and target decomposition, independent output verification, explicit parameters, and total resource accounting.

attack_routes.title: Evidence and supply-chain integrity
attack_routes.scope: Skeleton lane for source, identity, build, benchmark, custody, incident, completeness, and correction integrity.

dependencies.rationale: Current cover evidence and package identity must be stable before broad arithmetic applicability promotion.
Arithmetic, map, subgroup, and solver claims need separate evidence profiles.
Evidence profiles require stable unit and assessment identities.
Taxonomy cells require exact units and frozen denominators.
Each route needs a route-specific evidence profile.
The route freeze must be grounded in a cited, searched public corpus.
Claims and sources need stable content-addressed identities.
The corpus supplies and revises taxonomy candidates without creating a blocking cycle.
Run receipts bind exact units, implementations, and evidence revisions.
Cost claims are promoted through explicit evidence gates.
Governance decisions refer to immutable assessment identities.
Governance enforces evidence transitions and corrections.
Performance review requires the shared accounting contract.
Current cover evidence promotion uses the independent review roles.
Cover arithmetic and subgroup claims require independent role review.
Taxonomy completeness and route findings are approved separately.
Corpus inclusion, provenance, and comparator decisions are reviewable.

governance.promotion_rule: A claim is promoted only when every profile-required evidence gate, authorization gate, exact revision binding, semantic check, and independent role approval passes.
governance.correction_rule: Corrections append a superseding assessment and preserve old evidence, decisions, and denominators; they never rewrite the frozen record.
